title: Same reward can be claimed multiple times in certain cases
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  The `ODefaultOperatorRewards` contract distributes rewards to operators based on their active stake. To prevent multiple claims, the contract tracks claimed amounts via: ```solidity claimed[eraIndex][recipient] ``` However, the recipient is derived from the `operatorKey` using: ```solidity address recipient = IOBaseMiddlewareReader(middlewareAddress).operatorByKey(abi.encode(input.operatorKey)); ``` The issue arises because operator keys can be reassigned over time by the middleware.
